messages:
sam: Heads-up — I hit a weird mypy/pyright error with the async client and autogenerated models in the sample app. Repro below.

sam: Minimal repro: we call client.jobs.create_job(...) which is typed to return CreateJobResponse | None, but the async paginator returns an AsyncIterator[CreateJobResponse]. mypy complains when I try to `async for r in client.jobs.list_jobs(...)` and then access r.job_id — it thinks r could be None.

sam: Example snippet:
```py
# sdk client (generated)
class JobsClient:
    async def list_jobs(self, *, page_size: int = 100) -> AsyncIterator[Optional[CreateJobResponse]]:
        ...

# caller
async for job in client.jobs.list_jobs(page_size=50):
    # mypy: error: "Optional[CreateJobResponse]" has no attribute "job_id"
    print(job.job_id)
```

yara: hmm, so generator yield type is Optional[...]? is that coming from the schema (nullable items) or our autogen wrapper?

sam: The underlying OpenAPI has items: { "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CreateJobResponse" } but some endpoints have nullable: true on the container level. autogen seems to propagate container-level nullable into the yielded item type. so list -> AsyncIterator[Optional[CreateJobResponse]] instead of AsyncIterator[CreateJobResponse].

alex: I can repro. In the codegen, we map: if container_nullable: item_type = Optional[item_type]. That was intended for sync list responses that can be null when the whole list is missing. But for paginated iterators we should treat container nullability as the iterator being empty rather than items being Optional.

mikey: Workarounds for app owners: `if job is None: continue` guard or `assert job is not None` before usage, but both are noisy. I used `from typing import cast` and `job = cast(CreateJobResponse, job)` as temporary.

sam: Proposed fix: change generator typing so AsyncIterator[item_type] when container is nullable but items aren't. Add a codegen unit test for a schema with nullable array vs nullable items.

alex: Will open a PR. Labels: devex, codegen, typing. Also will add a migration note: older clients generated before fix might have Optional in signatures; recommend pinning sdk >= X.Y.Z after release.

ci-bot: CI check started for branch fix/codegen-iterator-nullable-1768 — 1 job queued. :gear:

yara: Also add a sampleapp test that runs mypy on the sample and fails CI if typing regressions appear. This keeps regressions from slipping back in.

sam: Agreed. Can we add a small mypy run step under devex/sampleapp in CI? It should be fast if we only check the public surface + examples.

alex: Good call. I'll add mypy to the sampleapp workflow and include a pinned types-versions matrix so flakes don't fail randomly.

mikey: Thanks — saved me from a bunch of casts. Also ping me for the PR review, I'll check for other places where container-nullability was misapplied.

sam: Thanks everyone. Filing a tracking ticket: GH #4821 (will link in PR).
